name: Panta Detroit CPC / DDEC VI Diagnostic Reference

sources.note: User-supplied 7-page DDEC VI CPC fault-code table; over 100 entries

usage_note: Curated source-grounded diagnostic knowledge, not a verbatim reproduction. Preserve exact SPN/FMI/PID-SID/flash-code relationships. CPC faults must be interpreted by exact Detroit generation and vehicle configuration. Do not condemn the CPC or connected component from a code alone.

documents.title: DDEC VI CPC fault-code table structure
documents.summary: The supplied DDEC VI CPC table organizes faults by SPN, FMI, PID/SID identifier, flash code and fault description. Diagnosis should preserve the complete combination because the same SPN can represent different failure modes depending on FMI and source/message context.

documents.title: DDEC VI CPC vehicle-speed and accelerator-pedal faults
documents.summary: Source entries include SPN 70 park-brake plausibility/J1939 source-signal faults; SPN 84 vehicle-speed failure, high/low circuits, anti-tamper checks, J1939 wheel-speed source errors/missing messages and drift-high plausibility; SPN 91 accelerator-pedal learn, high/low circuit, PWM frequency/not-learned/idle/range and EEC2 message faults; SPN 558 idle-validation switch faults; SPN 2623 GAS1/GAS2 or pedal-channel faults; and SPN 3510 accelerator-pedal supply-voltage high/low/missing conditions.

documents.title: DDEC VI CPC engine protection and basic sensor faults
documents.summary: The table includes SPN 98 oil-level high/low/very-low; SPN 100 oil-pressure low/very-low; SPN 107 air-filter restriction and circuit high/low; SPN 110 coolant-temperature high/very-high; SPN 111 coolant-level low/very-low and circuit high/low; SPN 168 battery-voltage/charging/powerdown conditions; and SPN 171 ambient-temperature erratic or missing/stopped J1587 data.

documents.title: DDEC VI CPC transmission and MCM engine-hours data faults
documents.summary: Source entries include SPN 191 ETC1/transmission output-shaft speed message faults; SPN 247 MCM engine-hours not received, implausible rate, higher-than-expected and lower-than-expected data; SPN 523 transmission-current-gear signal erratic/missing; and SPN 524 ETC2 message missing.

documents.title: DDEC VI CPC cruise-control and brake-switch faults
documents.summary: The table contains CCVS message loss and cruise-control enable/coast/accelerate source-message faults, service-brake plausibility and source-message faults, plus SET/RESUME circuit failure. These are source/message/circuit faults and should not automatically be treated as failed switches without checking the multiplex/J1939 path.

documents.title: DDEC VI CPC controller, memory and data-link faults
documents.summary: Source entries include SPN 608 J1708 data-link failure; SPN 609 CPC2 hardware failure; SPN 615 missing transmission DM1; SPN 625 ECAN diagnostic-message, MCM system-ID and ECAN-link faults; SPN 628 XFLASH/OS-task faults; SPN 629 CPC hardware/software mismatch and XFLASH write error; SPN 630 EEPROM/checksum/SCR and MCM fault-table/software/storage conditions; and SPN 639 J1939 data-link failure. For clustered network faults, establish power/ground and data-link integrity before controller replacement.

documents.title: DDEC VI CPC digital-output fault family SPN 701-715
documents.summary: The source lists a concentrated CPC digital-output family from SPN 701 through 715 with circuit-high/circuit-low conditions; selected entries also include open-circuit conditions. SPN 707 references the CEL/AWL lamp output, while SPN 713 includes an open-circuit entry and TOP2 shift failure. Use the exact SPN/FMI/PID-SID and vehicle wiring assignment because the numeric output label alone does not identify the physical load on every configuration.

documents.title: DDEC VI CPC ABS, retarder and remote-pedal communication faults
documents.summary: The source includes SPN 904 missing EBC2/ABS and front-axle-speed erratic/missing signals; SPN 972 throttle-inhibit plausibility due to vehicle speed; SPN 973 missing EBC1 and engine-retarder selection missing/erratic; and SPN 974 remote accelerator-pedal supply/circuit high/low faults.

documents.title: DDEC VI CPC PTO, starter lockout and adaptive-cruise faults
documents.summary: The table includes PTO switch conflicts, missing CM1, digital-output faults, starter-lockout short/open faults, adaptive-cruise message/device errors, tachograph TCO1/speed signal faults and an Optimized Idle safety-loop fault.

documents.title: DDEC VI CPC DPF regeneration switch and multiplex faults
documents.summary: SPN 3695 covers manual DPF regen/inhibit switch rationality and DPF regen-inhibit multiplex messages containing data-error/SNV indicators, stopping, or not being received during the ignition cycle. SPN 3696 covers corresponding DPF regen-force multiplex message data-error/SNV, stopped-arriving and not-received conditions. These faults describe switch/message paths and are not the same as DPF soot-load faults.

documents.title: Detroit CPC communication diagnostic priority
documents.summary: For CPC/MCM/ACM communication complaints, capture all module faults and determine which modules or messages are actually missing. Address supply-voltage faults, recent programming/configuration changes, connectors and wiring, then test the applicable J1939/J1708/ECAN network and module power/grounds. Multiple communication codes can share one root cause.
